create.name: Renée Vos de Wael
create.bio:
Renée Vos de Wael is an animal communicator, Reiki practitioner and meditation guide who works under the name Sagittarius Way from Calgary, Alberta. She says the ability to sense what animals feel came to her as a girl, when talking with animals gave her a kind of understanding she did not find among people, and she has built her work around that bond. She has long worked hands-on with horses.

In sessions held by phone or Zoom she tunes in to an animal through images, words, feelings and energy, passes on what it seems to want its person to know, and answers the owner's questions; she also reaches out to animals that have died. For people rather than pets she offers readings to meet an animal spirit guide, and longer Sacred Connection sessions that bring together spirit animals, Reiki and meditations made for the person. Her guided meditations, on Insight Timer and her YouTube channel, are built around animal guides such as the fox, the owl, the horse and the butterfly, and she teaches the Usui Reiki hand positions for use on yourself and your animals. She runs a weekly online gathering with an animal guide and a monthly membership, and has written a short free ebook on the love languages of dogs.

courses.title: Meet Your Animal Spirit Guide
courses.description: A one-to-one reading to find out which animal guide walks with you, what it stands for and what it has to say, with suggestions for bringing its qualities into daily life.

courses.title: Sacred Connection Sessions
courses.description: A series of private sessions that combine Reiki, contact with your spirit animals and meditations written for you, with the aim of giving you your own way back to that connection between sessions.

courses.title: Animal Communication Session (1 hour)
courses.description: An hour by phone or Zoom in which she tunes in to your animal, shares what it is feeling and wants you to know, and answers your questions about it. A thirty-minute version is also offered.

courses.title: Sagittarius Way Membership
courses.description: A monthly membership with her courses on dogs' love languages and animal spirit connection, a Reiki circle for animals, tailored guidance and direct contact with her.

courses.title: Awaken Your Soul: A Sacred Gathering With Animal Spirit Guides
courses.description: An Insight Timer course of guided journeys, each meeting a different animal spirit guide and the quality it brings.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Trusting What You Already Know | Owl Spirit Animal
courses.description: An Insight Timer course with the owl as guide, on listening to your own inner knowing and trusting it.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Renée Vos de Wael on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations led by animal guides such as the duck, owl, woodpecker and dragon, with nature imagery and short spirit animal courses. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: How to Speak Your Dog's Love Language (free ebook)
free_resources.description: Her short ebook on five ways dogs give and receive affection, from touch and time together to praise and routine, sent free by email.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations with Animals
free_resources.description: A page on her site gathering free guided meditation videos with animal guides, among them the butterfly, the fox and two horse spirits.

Her main paid work is animal communication for pet owners; the spiritual teaching is in her spirit-animal meditations, Reiki and spirit guide sessions. A human may want to confirm she fits.

Only one photo confirmed (her site's portrait of her with a horse); the YouTube avatar is a logo and no Insight Timer photo URL could be read.
